description_en: Queries the review status of a card message template and returns review information from mobile phone manufacturers
description_zh: 查询卡片短信模板审核状态，返回手机厂商审核相关信息
name: QueryCardSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The code of the card message template. Valid values:

The value of the TemplateCode response parameter returned after you call the [CreateCardSmsTemplate](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~) operation is the code of the newly created card message template.

You can also log on to the console and go to the China Card Messages (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page to view the card message template code on the Template Management tab
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。取值：

调用[创建卡片短信模板](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~)接口后，返回参数TemplateCode即为新创建的卡片短信模板Code。

您也可登录控制台国内卡片短信 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面，在模板管理页签查看卡片短信模板Code
parameters.name: template_code

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

items.description_en:
The template information. The specific information is subject to the actual response.
tmpName: the template name.
tmpCode: the template code.
state: the template review status. 0: under review. 1: approved. 2: rejected.
tmpOps: the list of mobile phone manufacturer reviews. (state: the review status from the manufacturer. vendorCode: the manufacturer information. remark: the review comments from the manufacturer.)
items.description_zh:
返回的模板信息，具体信息以实际返回值为准。
tmpName：模板名称。
tmpCode：模板Code。
state：模板审核状态。0：审核中，1：审核通过。2：审核未通过
tmpOps：手机厂商审核列表。（state：手机厂商审核状态。vendorCode：手机厂商信息。remark：手机厂商审核意见。）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
